values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing' (DEC's 2026 campground summary). A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 73 campsites (the park description still says 60); equipment lengths 20-40 ft (29 at 40 ft), 5 pull-throughs, the rest back-in. Built to be fully accessible: most campsites and all restrooms and shower buildings meet accessibility standards.
